parts:

code from the site. However, I can't get any R code to run!

<% x=2; print(x); %>

My httpd.conf file has the following lines:


<Location /test/helloworld>
SetHandler r-handler
RFileHandler /var/www/R/test.R
</Location>

Can someone please tell me why this isn't working??
